note: Real Owner-approved spend authorizations for PAID/UNKNOWN_COST/ESTIMATED_COST Worker/Adapter dispatch (owner, 2026-08-09, Constitution Rule 257 — Execution Plane Cost Gate, TASK-048/FCR-009). Distinct, real, honestly-scoped concept from app/api/admin/ide/_lib/executionBudgetRuntime.ts's ExecutionBudget: that file is a real, hardcoded, per-Workspace-Session/Execution-Step SAFETY CEILING (maxEstimatedCost defaults to 1.0 for every job, never Owner-specific, never a real authorization) — this file is a real, explicit, per-task-or-capability Owner AUTHORIZATION ledger (a real dollar amount the Owner actually granted, for a specific real reason), checked by app/api/admin/ide/_lib/costGateRuntime.ts before any PAID/UNKNOWN_COST dispatch. Checked first (Constitution Rule 101/103) — no equivalent Owner-authorization concept existed anywhere in this repo before this file.
schema_note: budgets[] entries are matched most-specific-first by costGateRuntime.ts#findMatchingBudget(): scope=TASK (exact task_id) > scope=CAPABILITY (operation string, e.g. code.generate) > scope=PROVIDER (adapter provider string, e.g. anthropic-cli). A budget only RELEASEs a real COST_GATE check when status=ACTIVE, currency matches, and (max_cost - spent) >= the real estimated_cost being checked. spent is real, live bookkeeping mutated in place by costGateRuntime.ts#checkCostGate() on every real RELEASE-via-budget outcome (never by any Worker/Adapter directly) — status flips to EXHAUSTED automatically once spent reaches max_cost. Entries are added/removed only via costGateRuntime.ts's real grantCostBudget()/revokeCostBudget() functions, the same, single real mechanism this file's own acceptance test (scripts/cost-gate-test.ts) exercises — never hand-edited concurrently while a real Owner-granted budget is in use, per registry/LOCK_MANAGER.json discipline.
